title: What's New in v2.9.65
notes: 📝 Spacious Ticket & Bug Note Editor: Replaced cramped single-line input with a generous multi-line textarea supporting full Enter/Return keys, spacing, and bullet points.
⚡ Quick Template Pills & Shortcut: Added 1-click resolution template buttons and Ctrl+Enter quick-save shortcut.
✨ Dedicated Admin Resolution Box: Public feedback cards now render developer notes in a styled, formatted card block preserving custom whitespace and paragraphs.

latestChanges: v2.9.65: Upgraded Bug/Feedback resolution note editor to a spacious multi-line textarea with quick templates and pre-wrap formatting
v2.9.64: Enabled debounced background cloud auto-save and streamlined the Save button with live sync status indicators
v2.9.63: Added real-time auto-calculation and locked summary inputs in Alliance Championship Admin Suite
v2.9.62: Added comprehensive Draw (Tie) support across Alliance Championship war room, archive vault, and leaderboards
